name: local-hide
note: ADR-D01's Local row (view.local, L in Global; in a live session the router's twist key KeyL keeps L, so the row runs here as a command, as the palette runs it). The row hides Local: its opening closes, the composite frame drops Local's pane and Global draws alone, the gate's G1. A drag in Global while Local is hidden turns the shared camera; the row again shows Local on the cap it framed, still linked, sent the shared spin the drag left.
